items:
Production asset sheet for an ORIGINAL top-down shopkeeping pixel-art RPG, native logical icons 32x32, enlarged nearest-neighbor pixel clusters, limited walnut/cream/teal/burgundy/brass palette. SIX columns and FIVE rows of exactly equal cells, 30 icons, each fully isolated on TRANSPARENT background with generous padding. No shadows (game draws contact shadows), no text, no borders, no grid. One specific object per cell. Do not substitute similar objects. Clear simple silhouettes readable at 32px, no noisy texture or tiny illustration details.
Row1: iron straight sword with steel blade; bronze spear with brown shaft; BLACK sword with dark blade and faint violet edge; brown leather torso armor; IRON HELMET (a helmet, not shield); round wooden shield with steel rim.
Row2: SMALL round bottle RED healing potion; LARGE square bottle RED healing potion with double gold bands; GREEN antidote bottle with leaf-shaped stopper; pale BLUE luminous MUSHROOM with visible stem; translucent teal slime membrane orb with a small dark nucleus; hooked BLACK BEAST CLAW with ivory broken root.
Row3: aged SILVER ring with tarnished band; faceted deep BLUE gemstone; flat grey STONE TABLET engraved with cyan runes (not scroll); leather-wrapped RED medicine field flask; narrow PURPLE elixir bottle; ornate GOLD and WHITE grand-elixir bottle.
Row4: fresh GREEN HERB bundle of three serrated leaves tied by a brown stem (absolutely not bread); rough grey rock with rusty IRON veins; rough charcoal rock with WHITE SILVER veins; rough dark rock with metallic GOLD veins; pale icy BLUE MITHRIL metal ore chunk; COPPER-ORANGE ORICHALCUM metal ore chunk.
Row5: angular PURPLE magic crystal stone with glowing core; transparent WHITE DIAMOND cut gemstone; knotted indigo CLOTH BUNDLE with two tied corners; brown woven SHOULDER SACK with single long strap; rectangular wooden PEDLAR BOX with leather straps; large CARAVAN PACK with two side sacks and rolled blanket.
Consistent orthographic 3/4 top-down item view, crisp handcrafted 32px pixel style. All items have distinct silhouette and correct color. Equal grid cell positions are essential. Transparent alpha, no opaque background.
furniture:
A modular furniture sprite atlas for an ORIGINAL top-down pixel art shopkeeping RPG, clean handcrafted native 32x32 tile aesthetic. FOUR separate furniture pieces in a precisely aligned 2 columns x 2 rows grid. Transparent alpha background, generous gaps. No room, no floor, no cast shadows, NO items, NO books, NO coins, NO bottles, NO plates, NO clutter anywhere.
TOP LEFT: wide merchant wooden COUNTER, walnut side panels, warm honey oak EMPTY broad flat tabletop, front visible, logical 64 pixels wide and 32 pixels tall. The tabletop must have clear empty display surface, straight rectangular edges and restrained brass corner accents.
TOP RIGHT: wooden display SHELF, logical 64 pixels wide and 64 pixels tall, two empty horizontal tiers with wide flat horizontal ledges, dark recessed back and vertical side posts; BOTH TIERS COMPLETELY EMPTY, suitable for adding separate product sprites later.
BOTTOM LEFT: rectangular wooden display TABLE, logical 64 pixels wide and 32 pixels tall, flat empty oak top, four short sturdy legs, not round, no cloth.
BOTTOM RIGHT: small wooden DESK, logical 64 pixels wide and 32 pixels tall, flat EMPTY top and drawers below, no props.
Consistent top-down front-face viewpoint across all four objects, uniform light upper-left, dark walnut outlines, cream highlights, muted warm wood, crisp chunky square pixel clusters, nearest-neighbor enlargement, no anti-aliasing, no noisy wood grain. Fit each sprite fully inside its own quadrant. Empty usable surfaces are mandatory.
merchantWalk:
Production WALK-CYCLE sprite sheet of ONE consistent original merchant character for a 32x32 pixel-art top-down shop RPG. Exactly FOUR equal columns and FOUR equal rows. Each cell one sprite. Transparent alpha background, no shadows, no labels, no grid. Logical frame32x32, character height26pixels, integer pixel clusters enlarged uniformly, sharp unfiltered pixel art, simple readable silhouette. Merchant: brown hair, teal tunic, small brown apron, brown boots, tan shoulder strap; no weapon, no hand-held items, no long cape.
Rows in EXACT order: row1 FRONT facing down, row2 LEFT profile, row3 RIGHT profile, row4 BACK facing up.
Columns in EXACT order, a smooth four-phase walk cycle: 1 left foot forward and right arm forward (contact); 2 feet passing together under hips with right knee slightly raised (passing); 3 right foot forward and left arm forward (opposite contact); 4 feet passing under hips with left knee slightly raised (opposite passing).
ALL frames must have IDENTICAL head, torso proportions, garment, scale and registration; head stays at same pixel height, pelvis stays centered, grounded foot baseline identical. Only arms and lower legs articulate. No squash/stretch, no body hopping, no size changes, no face changes. Side profiles keep looking same direction for the ENTIRE row. Back row shows only back of head and apron ties. Crisp 32px game production sprite, restricted 12-color palette, no texture noise, no antialiasing.
